title: Vainglory
summary: VAINGLO'RY, noun [vain and glory.] Exclusive vanity excited by one's own performances; empty pride; undue elation of mind. He hath nothing of vainglory Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory

inlines.v: VAINGLO'RY, noun [vain and glory.] Exclusive vanity excited by one's own performances; empty pride; undue elation of mind. He hath nothing of vainglory Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory Philippians 2:3.
